itens.trecho: Uma belíssima produção italiana. Se há alguma coisa que consegue provocar sérios problemas de expressão ao mais galanteador e fluente dos homens é o olhar ardente da mulher amada.
A beautiful Italian production. If there is something that manages to cause serious expression problems in the most flirtatious and fluent of men, it is the ardent gaze of the girl he loves.

With things unstable in his native Chile, renowned poet "Neruda" (Philippe Noiret) takes refuge on a small Italian island where his arrival is greeted with little more than a realisation that they are going to need to hire an extra postman! Step forward "Mario" (Massimo Troisi).
